summary: Describes verifying signed collections with GPG keyrings, adding extra detached signatures with `--signature`, using a requirements.yml, and verifying offline using signatures saved at install time.
questions: How do I check the GPG signature of a collection I already installed?
Can I supply extra detached signatures when verifying a collection?
Is it possible to verify a signed collection without contacting the Galaxy server?
Where does Ansible keep the signatures it downloaded when installing a collection?

answer_card.title: Verify signed collections
answer_card.answer_md:
- Verify with a keyring:
```bash
ansible-galaxy collection verify my_namespace.my_collection --keyring ~/.ansible/pubring.kbx
```
- Add extra signatures with `--signature <url-or-file>` (repeatable).
- Works with `-r requirements.yml` too.
- Signatures from the distribution server are saved alongside installed collections, so `--offline` can verify without querying the server.
- Signing support depends on the distribution server; not all servers provide signatures.
